semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Tokushima University Yotsuyanagi Laboratory conducts research relevant to semiconductor testing and design, particularly in the area of fault detection and counterfeit prevention.
summary: The Yotsuyanagi Laboratory at Tokushima University focuses on research related to integrated circuit design and testing methodologies. Their work includes developing boundary scan technology for delayed fault testing and ensuring chip authenticity, which are critical for advancing semiconductor reliability and security.
capabilities: Boundary scan design method incorporating time-to-digital conversion for delayed fault testing
Implementation methods for physically unclonable function (PUF) to determine chip authenticity
